champion_choice.rule: blend-v2 (fra.blend:forecast) is the champion if it beat the production logit on the long walk-forward test, else logit-v1 stays champion
champion_choice.decided: decided and promoted at 2026-10-31 17:35 UTC on the long test (runtime/history.jsonl), written down here afterwards (18:13 UTC): the rule is post hoc, not pre-registered
champion_choice.outcome: blend-v2 is champion: long test (issues 2026-06-01 .. 2026-10-30, 152 days) paired Brier(1,6,24,48) blend - logit -0.0041 [-0.0067, -0.0018] (1-day blocks; 3-day blocks [-0.0071, -0.0014]); Brier over all 48 leads -0.0042 [-0.0069, -0.0019]; part before 15 Sep (valid < 2026-09-15) -0.0043 [-0.0073, -0.0016]
champion_choice.in_sample: All of Jun-Oct 2026 was used to select the blend design (waves 1 and 2: Part A specification, Part B DEFAULT, anticipate='mean', the 50/50 weight, BLEND_CHANGE_PARAMS / BLEND_P48_COEF, the data layer, CLEAN_LABELS; ~38 integration and 21 phase-2 variants were compared on these rows); no part of the long test is selection-free for the blend, and its long-test gain is an in-sample upper bound. Only the holdout decides.

streams.official: data/archive/issued/forecast_YYYYMMDDTHH.csv (+ .json, .features.parquet): the champion, issued once per hour by fra-archive.timer (:30 local time since 2026-10-31 18:57 UTC; :12 before, see amendment A6) from the runtime data/archive/runtime/current; the .json records variant, runtime, model sha256 and, for the blend, the decision part's status
streams.shadow: data/archive/issued_shadow/<variant>/forecast_YYYYMMDDTHH.*: every challenger, the same issue hour, in its own frozen runtime and process right after the champion, with the same prognosis snapshot and the radar hours the champion fetched (run_cache/); weather inputs are fetched by each variant itself seconds to a minute later
streams.never_backfilled: a missing hour stays missing; shadows are not issued if the official forecast of the hour is older than 20 min
streams.embedded_logit: the official blend-v2 file also holds p_od25_logit = the logit-v2 model on exactly the champion's inputs; used as a consistency check of the logit-v2 shadow stream, not for the decision

truth.od: flown operating direction of the radar hour starting at the valid time: fra.labels.to_labels(fra.labels.load_counts(), bridge="night") on data/inaa_counts.csv (INAA FANOMOS radar, appended hourly by the live job, re-checked once >= 6 h later): majority of west/east movements if >= 4 movements, carried (<= 8 h) only through the night ban and fetched quiet hours, never across a daytime hour that was not fetched; hours without a label are not scored; fra.scoring reports per window the valid hours observed / bridged / unlabelled
truth.rwy18: rwy18_open of the same labels: judged only in busy hours (>= 15 movements, from 06 local), closed = no RWY 18 departure

analysis.rows: identical rows only: issue hours that BOTH compared variants issued (official or shadow), leads 1, 6, 24 and 48, valid hour labelled; pooled = all these rows with equal weight
analysis.ci: 95 % percentile CI of a block bootstrap: blocks = 3 consecutive UTC days of the valid time (fixed calendar blocks, fra.evalkit.day_blocks(block_days=3)), 2000 draws, seed 20261031 (fra.evalkit.bootstrap, block_days=3; fra.scoring.BLOCK_DAYS); paired differences are computed on the same resampled blocks. Sensitivity (reported, not decisive): the pooled Brier difference with 1- and 7-day blocks (live_record_variants.json -> brier_pooled_by_block_days). Reason (amendment A3): the daily paired Brier differences are autocorrelated (long test: lag-1 0.21, lag-2 0.07), so 1-day blocks give CIs ~15-25 % too narrow (long test blend - logit: width 0.0048 with 1-day, 0.0057 with 3-day, 0.0065 with 7-day blocks)

primary_window.name: holdout_4w
primary_window.note: the last valid hour of the window is 2026-11-30 23:00 UTC; its radar hour is stored >= 100 min after its end and re-checked >= 6 h later, so the evaluation waits until 08:00 UTC

extension_window.name: holdout_8w
extension_window.used_only_if: the primary decision is inconclusive (rule D3)

analysis.primary_metric: Brier score of P(OD 25) pooled over leads 1, 6, 24 and 48
analysis.primary_comparison: blend-v2 (champion) minus logit-v2 (the same logit alone, same code and data layer): negative = blend better
secondary: S1 accuracy at 24 h (P(OD 25) >= 0.5 vs flown OD), paired blend-v2 - logit-v2 with the same bootstrap

S2 event accuracy of the next change (fra.changetime definitions as in fra.scoring.switch_events: issue hours whose whole 48 h horizon is labelled; an actual change lasts >= 2 flown hours; a predicted change is a hit within +-3 h; 'no change' predicted and observed counts as correct), per variant on the common issue hours; paired difference with a day-block bootstrap over issue days (fra.evalkit.bootstrap_means)

S3 RWY 18 warnings: P(RWY 18 open) < 0.8 at any lead: closed hours flagged and false alarms (per 1,000 forecast hours), plus RWY 18 Brier pooled over leads 1/6/24/48; blend-v2 and logit-v2 use the same RWY 18 logit (fra.blend.RWY18_MODE = 'logit'), so this compares the new logit with logit-v1 and hackathon; closures are rare (34 closure hours in 14 months), so S3 is descriptive unless >= 10 closure hours occur
S4 Brier over all 48 leads and accuracy at 1, 6 and 48 h (paired, same bootstrap)

S5 accuracy on changed hours (flown OD at the valid hour differs from the issued od_now) at 1 h and 6 h: the long test showed the blend worse at 6 h (-5.8 pp [-10.4, -2.2]); watched, not a decision criterion
descriptive: blend-v2 and logit-v2 vs logit-v1 (the previous official system: old code, od_now from the newest partly published radar hour, stitched live ECMWF forecast) and vs hackathon (the frozen hackathon model); their long-test numbers are not comparable (logit-v1's backtest used the complete hour [t-1h, t), which is not available live)
all variants vs the published INAA prognosis, the official rules on the forecast wind and persistence (fra.scoring baselines on the champion's issue hours)
coverage: expected vs issued hours per variant; blend fallback rate (share of champion issues with blend_ok = false)
od_now checks: od_now_vs_source_hour (should be ~1.0 for the new code) and od_now_vs_full_hour (staleness)

decision_rule.D1_confirm: at holdout_4w: if the upper CI bound of Brier(blend-v2) - Brier(logit-v2) is < 0, blend-v2 is confirmed as champion
decision_rule.D2_demote: at holdout_4w: if the lower CI bound is > 0, blend-v2 is demoted: logit-v2 becomes champion (registry roles swapped, its runtime promoted), blend-v2 stays as a challenger
decision_rule.D3_inconclusive: otherwise (CI includes 0) blend-v2 stays champion and the comparison is extended to holdout_8w; there: confirm if the upper bound < 0; demote if the lower bound > 0 OR the point estimate is > 0; else (point estimate <= 0, CI includes 0) blend-v2 stays champion
decision_rule.secondary_role: secondary metrics never override the primary rule; they are reported together with the decision and can motivate a NEW pre-registered variant, never a silent change
decision_rule.other_variants: logit-v1 and hackathon are references; no decision is taken on them in this plan
decision_rule.power_note: on the long test the CI half-width of the paired difference was ~0.0025 over 152 days; over 28 days it is expected to be ~0.006 and over 56 days ~0.004, so a true gain of the size seen on the long test (-0.004) will often be inconclusive at 4 weeks; D3 handles that by default to the long-test choice

fixed_during_holdout: model files of every variant (sha256 above; read-only copies under data/archive/models/<variant>/); no retraining: the weekly retrain timer stays disabled (data/archive/RETRAIN_PAUSED); the decision bundle is not refitted

forecast code of every variant (runtime tags and module sha256 above); fra.blend weights (0.5 / 0.5), N_PATHS 200, Part B DEFAULT parameters, BLEND_CHANGE_PARAMS / BLEND_P48_COEF, fra.changetime PARAMS / P48_COEF, RWY18_MODE; the Part B analogue library inputs (frozen read-only copy data/archive/models/blend-v2/library/, registry models.library, sha256 per file in its MANIFEST.json)

the data layer: od_now from the last complete radar hour (fra.dataset.KNOWN_LAG_H = 2, read by the job at :30 local time, ~90 min after that hour ended), ICON-EU fill, the as-of rules for the ECMWF / ICON runs (a served run is used only if complete for the hours the forecast needs, else the run one cycle earlier; every fallback is recorded in the issued .json live_inputs)
this analysis plan: metric, rows, windows, bootstrap, decision rule
allowed_changes: scoring, report and site code that does not change any issued forecast (new runtime snapshots are logged in data/archive/runtime/history.jsonl; the forecast-module sha256 must stay as registered)

operations fixes needed to keep the hourly job running; if a fix changes the forecast code or a model of a variant, that variant gets a new name (e.g. blend-v2.1), its record restarts at the change and the primary comparison is done separately before and after it

data files the live forecast reads at run time keep growing as in normal operation (radar counts); the Part B library of blend-v2 is read from its frozen copy, so refreshes of data/ifs_runs*.parquet, icon_runs.parquet or metar_full.parquet do not reach it

snapshots during the holdout are made with `ops.runtime snapshot --base <current tag> --files <scoring/site files>`; ops.runtime promote refuses a runtime whose forecast modules differ from this registration (unless explicitly overridden for a NEW variant name); every run records the check in runs.jsonl (prereg)

handling.missing_hours: not imputed; only issue hours both variants issued are compared; coverage is reported
handling.blend_fallback: an hour in which the decision part failed and blend-v2 issued the logit (blend_ok = false) still counts as blend-v2 (intention to treat)
handling.shadow_failures: a challenger hour that failed or timed out is missing for that pair
handling.label_corrections: late or corrected radar hours are picked up automatically; the analysis uses the labels as of the evaluation time

leakage: every variant uses only information available at issue time: the logit models (blend-v2 / logit-v2) were refit on 2026-10-31 on labels up to 2026-10-30 11:00 UTC, the decision bundle on rows known before 2026-10-31 16:00 UTC (labels up to 2026-10-30 11:00 UTC); live inputs are fetched at issue time with the as-of rules of training; no issue time >= 2026-11-01 was used for any choice in this plan
